messages:
alex: PR opened: docs#1287 — updated SOC2 audit export doc + code examples. noticed two issues: 1) curl example missing --header 'Content-Type: application/jsonl' 2) link to redaction guide 404. raising for review.
meera: thanks! pinging legal-ops for SOC2 phrasing :eyes:
jonathan: quick look — code block issue is real. we also changed field name from user_id to subject_id in the export, so examples need to reflect that.
sam: I can patch the curl header + field name. legal-ops, can you confirm redaction language? we replaced 'anonymize' with 'pseudonymize' in policy.
legal-ops: Confirmed — use 'pseudonymize' for SOC2 docs. Also prefer 'retention period' phrasing: 'retention period (TTL)'. avoid 'delete on request' phrasing.
alex: thanks — Sam, can you also add a short note about retention TTL default (90 days) and link to the retention config? that's in infra docs, link is /internal/retention-config (currently private).
sam: pushing a commit now. patch includes:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/jsonl' \
  -d @export_request.json
```
and sample export row example updates subject_id -> subject_id (oops) — fixed.
meera: FYI we should avoid embedding internal-only URLs in public docs. alex, can you swap to the public retention page once it's live, or add a note 'internal link — contact support'?
alex: good catch. I'll put a placeholder: 'See retention docs (support.redwood.ai/retention) — link pending'.
jonathan: deploy-bot shows doc build failed for markdown lint (long line in example). small style fix: wrap code block in indented list.
sam: fixed lint in next commit. also added short example of redaction workflow:
```
Example export row (JSONL):
{"subject_id":"user-123", "action":"login", "timestamp":"2026-03-20T12:34:56Z", "details": {"ip":"REDACTED"}}
```
legal-ops: approved wording for SOC2 section. please remove 'anonymize' and add a parenthetical: (pseudonymization is reversible under controlled conditions).
alex: ok merging after CI green. anyone want to do a quick once-over before merge?
meera: LGTM :thumbsup:
sam: merging in 10.
deploy-bot: docs site build succeeded — published to staging.
alex: thanks everyone — will follow up to replace placeholder link when public page is live.
